mapper.sql: id, video_id, nature_content_status, optimize_content_status, has_diagnosis_report, diagnosis_oss_name, user_id, tenant_id, create_date, update_date, is_deleted, nat_set_time, opt_set_time, nat_set_job, opt_set_job
mapper.select: SELECT anchorVideoDetail.id, anchorVideoDetail.video_id, anchorVideoDetail.nature_content_status, anchorVideoDetail.optimize_content_status, anchorVideoDetail.has_diagnosis_report, anchorVideoDetail.diagnosis_oss_name, anchorVideoDetail.user_id, anchorVideoDetail.tenant_id, anchorVideoDetail.create_date, anchorVideoDetail.update_date, anchorVideoDetail.is_deleted, anchorVideoDetail.nat_set_time, anchorVideoDetail.opt_set_time, anchorVideoDetail.nat_set_job, anchorVideoDetail.opt_set_job FROM tb_anchor_video_detail AS anchorVideoDetail LEFT JOIN tb_anchor_video AS anchorVideo ON anchorVideoDetail.video_id = anchorVideo.video_id WHERE anchorVideo.analysis_status = 2 AND anchorVideo.is_deleted = 0 AND anchorVideoDetail.is_deleted = 0 AND ( -- 条件为：自然原文内容，生成中，没有扫描到的，来源是服务器的 (anchorVideoDetail.nature_content_status = 1 AND anchorVideoDetail.nat_set_job = 0 AND anchorVideoDetail.nature_source_type = 0) OR -- 条件为：优化原文内容，生成中，没有扫描到的，来源是服务器的 (anchorVideoDetail.optimize_content_status = 1 AND anchorVideoDetail.opt_set_job = 0 AND anchorVideoDetail.optimize_source_type = 0) ) ORDER BY anchorVideoDetail.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
